name: Adaptive Burn Hook
mechanic: Burns a slice of tokens bought and banks ETH from tokens sold.
plain: On buys it burns a configurable percentage of the token output; on sells it captures ETH into a vault. Both rates are admin-adjustable and capped at 5%.
rules: Buys burn a configurable share of the token output (max 5%).
Sells divert a configurable share of ETH into a vault.
